about: Experience Mr. Driller originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Take the role of our hero, Susumu Hori, and use your drill to dig, dig, dig your way through the blocks in this action puzzle game! Choose from a variety of modes like the original Arcade mode, Survival mode where you see how far down you can dig, and the race-to-the-goal Time Attack mode. Dodge the falling blocks to make them disappear as you dig your way to 5000 feet underground!

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Mr. Driller originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
